title: Soap, Buckets, and Sunlight  (Jabón, cubos y luz del sol)

segments.t: Llegada la tarde del domingo, Hannah, Caleb y Owen se arremangan en la habitación nueve con dos cubos de agua tibia jabonosa y paños limpios de algodón. Escucha primero toda la escena.
Take the lower panes, Hannah; Caleb and I can reach the top arch from the ladder.
Dip the sponge in warm water with a drop of vinegar, zero streaks on old glass!
Whoa, look at that first square I wiped! Blue sky and green leaves!
Remember when mom made us wash the kitchen windows every spring, Caleb?
You always splashed water on my shirt and blamed the wind!
Careful up there, you two. Keep the soapy water in the bucket!
Look through the clean glass now: you can see the whole courtyard lantern line!
When we open the outside shutters tomorrow, sunlight will pour across all four tables.
Wait, Caleb, didn't you say your train home leaves tonight at seven?
I called my studio partner and moved my ticket to Saturday morning.
Really?! You are staying in Portland until Friday's opening night?!
Nothing could pull me away before Room Nine opens!
Recorramos ahora cada frase de la escena.
Take the lower panes, Hannah; Caleb and I can reach the top arch from the ladder.
'Encárgate de los cristales de abajo, Hannah; Caleb y yo alcanzamos el arco superior desde la escalera.'
Dip the sponge in warm water with a drop of vinegar, zero streaks on old glass!
'Moja la esponja en agua tibia con una gota de vinagre: ¡cero marcas en el vidrio viejo!'
Whoa, look at that first square I wiped! Blue sky and green leaves!
'¡Guau, miren ese primer cuadro que limpié! ¡Cielo azul y hojas verdes!'
Remember when mom made us wash the kitchen windows every spring, Caleb?
'¿Te acuerdas de cuando mamá nos hacía lavar las ventanas de la cocina cada primavera, Caleb?'
You always splashed water on my shirt and blamed the wind!
'¡Tú siempre me salpicabas agua en la camisa y le echabas la culpa al viento!'
Careful up there, you two. Keep the soapy water in the bucket!
'Cuidado ahí arriba, ustedes dos. ¡Mantengan el agua jabonosa dentro del cubo!'
Look through the clean glass now: you can see the whole courtyard lantern line!
'Miren ahora a través del cristal limpio: ¡se ve toda la hilera de farolillos del patio!'
When we open the outside shutters tomorrow, sunlight will pour across all four tables.
'Cuando abramos los postigos de fuera mañana, la luz del sol entrará a raudales por las cuatro mesas.'
Wait, Caleb, didn't you say your train home leaves tonight at seven?
'Espera, Caleb, ¿no dijiste que tu tren a casa sale esta noche a las siete?'
I called my studio partner and moved my ticket to Saturday morning.
'Llamé a mi socio del estudio y cambié mi billete para el sábado por la mañana.'
Really?! You are staying in Portland until Friday's opening night?!
'¿¡De verdad!? ¿¡Te quedas en Portland hasta la noche de inauguración del viernes!?'
Nothing could pull me away before Room Nine opens!
'¡Nada podría arrancarme de aquí antes de que abra la habitación nueve!'
Volvamos a escuchar toda la escena seguida.
Take the lower panes, Hannah; Caleb and I can reach the top arch from the ladder.
Dip the sponge in warm water with a drop of vinegar, zero streaks on old glass!
Whoa, look at that first square I wiped! Blue sky and green leaves!
Remember when mom made us wash the kitchen windows every spring, Caleb?
You always splashed water on my shirt and blamed the wind!
Careful up there, you two. Keep the soapy water in the bucket!
Look through the clean glass now: you can see the whole courtyard lantern line!
When we open the outside shutters tomorrow, sunlight will pour across all four tables.
Wait, Caleb, didn't you say your train home leaves tonight at seven?
I called my studio partner and moved my ticket to Saturday morning.
Really?! You are staying in Portland until Friday's opening night?!
Nothing could pull me away before Room Nine opens!
Los altos ventanales en arco dejan entrar por fin el verdor del patio, ¡y Caleb alarga su estancia hasta la noche de inauguración! Nos vemos ahora mismo afuera frente a los postigos.
See you later!
